install_metadata: create a Setup instance and call install_metadata to generate embeddings for views catalog and store them in views_idx.csv
install_views: run install_views to execute create_db.sql and import views into a SQLite database named views_db.sqlite
verbalize: build a function that verbalizes timeline episodes into formatted text with metadata for embedding storage
install_data_embeddings: run install_data_embeddings to load timeline.json, generate OpenAI embeddings, and save a FAISS vector store to timeline.pkl
main_setup: run the main setup script with a datasource directory argument to prepare metadata, views DB, and timeline embeddings for querying
